descriptionChirho: Inner cognitive activity — what one thinks, reflects upon, or contemplates inwardly, whether of God or of humans.
Deliberate forward-looking designs of the will — plans, purposes, or counsels that one resolves to carry out.
Hostile or wicked machinations devised against others — schemes, plots, and cunning stratagems with malicious intent.
Artistic or technical inventiveness — the skillful devising of designs, patterns, or inventions, especially in craftsmanship (e.g., tabernacle work).
